content: कञ्चुकिन् {%a.%} Furnished with armour or mail. --{%m.%} .²1 An attendant on the womenʼs apartments, a chamberlain; (an important character in dramas); अन्तःपुरचरो वृद्धो विप्रो गुणगणान्वितः . सर्वकार्यार्थकुशलः कञ्चुकीत्यभिधीयते .. (he must be a Brāhmaṇa, very old, <ab>&c.</ab>; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>V. 3</ls>. and <ls>Ś. 5. 3</ls>). .²2 A libidinous man, debauchee. .²3 A serpent. .²4 A door-keeper. .²5 Barley.
